target_customer: Small and medium businesses in India with blue-collar staff, paying for attendance and payroll software
problem: Most Indian small businesses track attendance on paper, calculate salaries in Excel and pay in cash, taking days per payroll run.
business_model: Mobile-first B2B SaaS for attendance, payroll and HR, later with credit profiles for workers
product_category: SMB payroll and workforce management app

founders.name: Nikhil Goel
founders.background_notes: Named on the YC page and Inc42 (Nov 2021). Background not given in opened sources.

founders.name: Peeyush Goyal
founders.background_notes: Named on the YC page and Inc42. Background not given in opened sources.

competitors.name: PagarBook
competitors.what: Payroll and attendance app for Indian SMEs

competitors.name: Khatabook
competitors.what: Ledger app with payroll offering (Pagar Khata)

competitors.name: OkCredit
competitors.what: Ledger app with staff product OKStaff

competitors.name: Smartstaff
competitors.funding_then: $4.3M seed from Blume, Nexus, Arkam, Gemba

competitors.name: Betterplace
competitors.funding_then: $24M Series C from Jungle Ventures and 3one4 Capital

technical_complexity.rationale: Mobile attendance, salary calculation and payouts for small firms; standard engineering with Indian compliance details.

defensibility.rationale: Payroll history and employee data create some stickiness, but rivals offered near identical features and the product was copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Ledger apps and funded rivals already sold the same wedge; SalaryBox kept raising and was still operating in 2026 per aggregator listings.

market_need_then: YC description cites 63 million small businesses with 90 percent managing payroll manually; Inc42 (Nov 2021) projected a large Indian HR payroll software market.

identity.voice_and_tone: Positioned with the tagline Gusto for India, later Workforce Operations, Simplified

brand_strength.rationale: Clear descriptive name and a sharp positioning line, but no press on the brand and easily confused with SalaryBook and PagarBook.

outcome_analysis: SalaryBox raised a pre-seed in May 2021 and a $4M seed in November 2021 shortly after YC, with over 1 million employees on payroll by then. It stayed active with a team of 40 and enterprise logos on its site, but no Series A was found, so it is a steady grower rather than a breakout, in a market with funded rivals.
notes: The pre-seed amount of $125K appears only on one aggregator (Uplers) and is unverified. The YourStory competitor source was identified through a search summary because the page returned 403; the YourStory Nov 2021 funding page also returned 403. Search summaries attribute IIT Roorkee degrees, a CMU masters and prior roles at Indifi, Practo, LeadGenius and Helpshift to the founders, but I did not open a source stating this, so founder backgrounds are null. FY25 revenue figures on aggregators are unverified. Founding year 2020 per Inc42 (May 2020).
